## 问题与变化 / Problem and change

关联 / Related Issue：Closes #

描述触发场景、变化后的行为与涉及模块。 / Describe the trigger, resulting behavior and affected modules.

## 验证 / Validation

提供可复现的命令、输入与预期；界面修改附截图。 / Provide repeatable commands, inputs and expected results; attach screenshots for UI changes.

## 影响与限制 / Impact and limitations

说明配置、数据、兼容性与 mock 边界；无则填「无 / None」。 / Explain configuration, data, compatibility and mock boundaries; use “None” where appropriate.

## 完成检查 / Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` 与模块检查通过。 / Root and module checks pass.
- [ ] 行为变化有必要测试。 / Behavior changes have relevant tests.
- [ ] 契约和中英文说明已同步。 / Contracts and both documentation languages are current.
- [ ] 未包含敏感信息或未授权素材。 / No sensitive information or unauthorized assets are included.
- [ ] Demo 仍可运行，或已说明影响。 / The demo works, or its impact is explained.
